name: Tanglin Trust School
summary: British curriculum staple in Portsdown — IGCSE into A-Level / IB pathway forks; west-central housing gravity is strong; infant/junior waits bite first.
body: Tanglin Trust delivers an English National Curriculum pathway toward IGCSEs with senior options that can fork toward A-Levels and/or IB depending on cohort year — confirm the live exit map with admissions before you treat “British school” as a single product. The Portsdown / one-north geography makes it a Holland Village, Dover, and west-central favourite — many families choose housing after a provisional year-group conversation, not before. Admissions are structured and competitive in infant and junior years; treat waitlist realism as part of the relocation critical path. Forum shortlists often pair Tanglin with Dulwich / Brighton / NLCS for British pathways when Tanglin waits are closed — keep a reach/match/safety set. For mobile teens, ask where last year’s leavers matriculated (UK vs elsewhere) and whether mid-stream Year 12 entry is even open — see the secondary IB/A-Level pathways guide. Fee stacks include the usual capital/bus/CCA surprises — compare five-year totals with UWCSEA Dover and other British/IB peers rather than brochure tuition alone. Singapore Citizen MOE-waiver cases are a separate admissions theatre; foreign-system schools facilitate, MOE decides.
waitlistNotes: Register as early as policy allows; infant/junior demand is often tighter than senior years — get dated availability in writing. Ask whether your year group is open, waitlist, or closed pending attrition — and which senior exam pathway seats remain.
